Initial release of the collections-email skill.

- Generates a multi-stage, polite-but-firm payment reminder email sequence for overdue invoices.
- Covers all stages from pre-due reminder to final notice, escalating tone appropriately.
- Ensures each message includes invoice details, amount due, and easy payment instructions.
- Flags interest/late fee and escalation steps for confirmation, staying within lawful and professional boundaries.
- Focuses on preserving client relationships while facilitating prompt payment.
